summary: Torakazu Doi was a philosopher and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University under Hajime Tanabe (~1922–1925). He held posts at Sagami Women's University and Dokkyo University (~1964–1971).

Torkel Brekke works in religious studies, Indology, and history and archaeology. He studied at the University of Oslo and the University of Oxford, and held posts at PRIO, Oslo Metropolitan University, and MF Norwegian School of Theology.

Toru Funayama is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Sinology who studied at Kyoto University and under Ernst Steinkellner (1991–1992). He held posts at Kyoto University (attested 1995–2019) and Kyushu University (attested 1999–2003).

Toru Haneda was a scholar of Iranian/Central Asian studies, Sinology, and history/archaeology. Educated at the University of Tokyo and Kyoto University, he served in multiple posts at Kyoto University from 1909 to 1948 and headed Toho Gakkai.

Toru Kumeji works in Buddhist studies and computational fields. He has held posts at the Center for Open Humanities Data and as a senior researcher at the Humanities Information Studies Institute (attested 2015).

Toru Sagara was a scholar of philosophy and Japanology who studied at the University of Tokyo under Tetsuro Watsuji (~1941–1944). He held posts at Ibaraki University (~1949–1955), the University of Tokyo (~1966–1982), and Kyoritsu Women's University (~1982–1992).

Toru Takahashi was a scholar of Sinology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies who graduated from the University of Tokyo (1898–1902). He held professorships at Keijo Imperial University (1926–1940), Fukuoka University (1949), and Tenri University (1950–1964).

Toru Tomabechi is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and Indology who studied at Kyoto University and the University of Lausanne. He held posts at Lausanne, IKGA, the Humanities Information Studies Institute, and Center for Open Humanities Data.
Toshiaki Yamada is a scholar of Sinology and religious studies. He studied at Toyo University from approximately 1966 to 1976 and later held a post there from approximately 1981 to 2017.

Toshifumi Goto is an Indologist and linguist who completed his PhD at the University of Erlangen-Nuremberg (-1982) under Karl Hoffmann and others. He later held posts as professor at Tohoku University and Osaka University.
Toshihide Unebe is a scholar in Buddhist studies who studied under Issai Funahashi. He held a post as professor at Doho University (attested 1991).

Toshihiko Izutsu was a scholar of philosophy, linguistics, and religious studies. He studied at Keio University, where he taught from 1937 to 1981, and later held posts at McGill University and the Iranian Institute of Philosophy.

Toshihiko Kimura is an Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Tohoku University (~1959–1963). He held posts at Tohoku University, Tokai Gakuin University (attested 1981–1987), and Shitennoji University (attested 2015).
Toshihiro Wada is an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Vashishtha Narayan Jha in 1981. He held a long-term post as professor at Nagoya University from approximately 1990 to 2019.

Toshiichi Endo is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Kelaniya and the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies, where he completed his doctoral thesis under Mahinda Palihawadana and W. S. Karunatillake.

Toshikazu Watanabe is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology. He held a research post at the Austrian Academy of Sciences (attested 2011–2015) and became a professor at Kokugakuin University in 2018.

Toshiki Osada is a linguist and Indologist who studied at Hokkaido University (~1973–1977). He has held posts at the Research Institute for Humanity and Nature as professor (~2003–2019) and at Kyoto University of the Arts.

Toshinori Ochiai is a Buddhist studies, Sinology, and Japanology scholar. He has held posts at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies, Kacho Junior College, the Institute for the Study of Ancient Manuscript Buddhist Canons, and IIBS.
Toshio Ando was a scholar in Buddhist studies who studied at Kyoto University from approximately 1930 to 1933. He held posts at Doho University and Otani University (~1949–1973).

Toshio Horiuchi is a Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Tokyo (~2002–2008). He held research positions at Toyo University (~2014–2020) and Zhejiang University (~2019).
